text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D after sizable gains felt rewarding, but I should judge each position by its future prospects, not just the gain since my cost basis.","Selling Stock E for a tiny gain after buying it back at a higher price shows that avoiding a loss can lead to unhelpful trading; I should reassess the investment on its merits.","My account value moved both down and up even when I made no trades, so I should consider portfolio-wide risk and diversification rather than focusing only on each stock's individual gain or loss."]}
